sections.title: Meeting preparation
sections.sql: select board,title,meeting_date,pack_due,missing_papers from v_pack_readiness where meeting_date>=current_date order by meeting_date

sections.title: Action chase
sections.sql: select board,title,owner,due_date,days_overdue,days_quiet from v_action_chase where days_overdue>0 or days_quiet>=14 order by days_overdue desc

sections.title: Work plan
sections.sql: select b.name as board,w.title,w.due_date from work_plan w join boards b on b.id=w.board_id where w.completed_on is null and w.due_date<=current_date+30 order by w.due_date

name: compliance
title: Governance record checks
subtitle: Evidence gaps for review, not a legal certification.

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select b.name as board,v.rule,v.record,v.finding,v.due_date,v.source from v_compliance v join boards b on b.id=v.board_id order by b.name,v.rule

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select b.name as board,d.title,d.outcome,d.decision_date,(select count(*) from actions a where a.decision_id=d.id) as linked_actions from decisions d join boards b on b.id=d.board_id order by d.decision_date desc
